# 🚽 Battle the Astros ⚔️

Enter the battlefield and take on the Astros in a fast-paced PvP experience inspired by the Skibidi universe. 🌌🔥

**📌 Current Version:** Alpha
**🔫 Combat:** Click to shoot
**📱 Mobile:** Fully supported
**🎮 Console:** **Added Console Support!**

### 🚀 Major Updates

* 🎮 **Added full console support**
* 🔄 Complete game revamp
* 🗺️ Improved and upgraded map
* ⚡ Major performance and optimization improvements
* 📉 Reduced lag and improved overall stability
* 🎮 Improved controls across all platforms
* ✨ New content and gameplay improvements

The game has received a **major overhaul**, with improved performance, a better map, expanded platform support, and many other changes. 🛠️🔥

More updates and features are planned as development continues! 🚧

📢 **Join our group and community server** to stay updated with development news, announcements, and upcoming content!
